item.title: PHYBOT Debuts PhyHand, a 23-DoF Direct-Drive Dexterous Hand, at the Canton Fair
item.description: The 750-gram hand has 23 active degrees of freedom and dual encoders. It has passed lab validation and can perform gestures; PHYBOT says fine grasping is still in development.

item.title: Shenzhen's International Quantum Academy Entangles Up to Six Phonon Modes on a 2D Chip
item.description: Two acoustic resonators, superconducting qubits and a tunable coupler on one chip produced genuinely entangled states across up to six phonon modes and moved them between resonators.

item.title: X-Humanoid Sets Out Its Roadmap for a Unified Embodied Model and Self-Evolving Robot Policies
item.description: At ROSCon China 2026, the Beijing center described four levels of generalization and a layered data plan built around a world model simulator, and introduced Pelican-Unify.

item.title: VAST Open-Sources EdenLive, a Real-Time Model That Renders Simple Game Footage as Detailed Video
item.description: Upstream code keeps the game state while EdenLive renders it into detailed frames. VAST says its 5B model tops 24 FPS at 720p on a single RTX 5090. Weights and code are open.

item.title: Xi'an Jiaotong Team Builds a Zero-Gate-Bias 2D Phototransistor to Spot Faint Grid Discharges
item.description: Gold nanoparticles and a 10nm ferroelectric gate let a WS2 device reach 1.36 x 10^14 Jones detectivity and a 9.51 ms response with no gate voltage, aimed at partial discharge monitoring.
